newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse approves Pannon GSM bond listing.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse approves Pannon GSM bond listing.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) has given its approval for the listing of bonds of mobile telephone company Pannon GSM Tavkozlesi Rt, the BSE said in a statement on Wednesday.

The bourse will list all three series of bonds from the company which received 30.5 billion forints worth of bids in February when it auctioned three-year (series A), four-year (series B) and five-year (series C) bonds totaling 24 billion. @

The bonds bear an interest rate of year-on-year CPI plus three percent, to be adjusted semi-annually, with interest added to the capital annually and the interest and capital to be paid on the day of maturity.
The issue was lead managed by ING Barings Rt and was guaranteed by ING Bank N.V.
